title: North of the lane: the back lane behind the canteen, the clinic
caption: The next of the island's neighbour blocks (work issue #142): behind the canteen, a back lane from the canteen's loading yard to the north street, the clinic on its own small court, office blocks with their doors on walks, trees in groups. Backdrop only: day 1 doesn't walk it, and the cameras look north over the canteen, so you see it on the island map (M).

sections.title: The island map
sections.caption: The plaza's tile now runs north to the clinic. Before, the canteen's back was bare lawn up to the tile's edge.

sections.title: Close up (the camera placed where the player can't go)
sections.caption: The clinic's court off the back lane, block_e2 by the junction with the north street, the canteen's loading yard, the trees between, and the clinic after work.

sections.title: The clinic, built again (#165)
sections.caption: You said the clinic was "way too basic, looks worse than the other buildings". Now each bay has its own framed window with a sill, the ground floor is a glass front frosted to the waist with the departments and the hours on it, and a glazed stair over the door carries クリニック down to the canopy and the green cross at the top. The door is under a canopy with クリニック CLINIC on it, up two steps or a ramp with handrails, with a tactile line from the lane. The court has a bench, a planter, a sign stone and a bike bay, and the roof has a stair house, a water tank and condensers. Before and after are from the same camera.
